maya (sec): Found a public paste referencing a 'wrapped token' with header 'KMS-ENVELOPE:v1' and a partner id 'sync-hub'. putting here for triage. :eyes:
vik (cloud): can you redact and paste the header + timestamp?
maya (sec): header: `KMS-ENVELOPE:v1|projects/our-prod/locations/global/keyRings/legacy/cryptoKeys/sync-legacy|v1` timestamp: 2026-04-02T02:11:08Z
rory (sre): that key ring was supposed to be retired. first containment: 1) pause partner webhook 2) disable legacy rewrap cron 3) snapshot audit logs for 3 days
ela (eng): ownership note: backup-reencrypt job still references that alias in infra/backup/legacy-config.yml. opening PR to remove.
vault-bot: vault-audit: transit/decrypt ops at 2026-04-02T02:10:59Z and 02:11:05Z (request ids redacted)
maya (sec): escalate to partner security (sent DM). partner claims accidental paste; they rotated locally. we still assume our surface may be affected.
vik (cloud): I'll revoke any long-lived SA keys tied to partner and create an ephemeral IAM binding for partner-proxy. command: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=partner-sync@our-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`
rory (sre): RBAC rollback: revert the audience wildcard change from yesterday. lock down to `partner-proxy` only and roll out canary.
ela (eng): plan for KMS/vault: - create new cryptoKey in new keyRing - re-encrypt backups -> gsutil cp + rewrap tool - disable old key for encrypt/decrypt - enable Vault audit forwarding to splunk with 90d retention
vault-bot: action queued: enable-audit splunk://splunk-team at 2026-04-02T03:00Z
maya (sec): notify legal/CSM after we confirm if any customer data was referenced. prepping template.
vault-bot: suggestion: run `grep -R "sync-legacy" /mnt/backups` and `git grep -n "sync-legacy"` across infra repos to locate references.
ela (eng): running search now; found hits in prod backups and one archived terraform state. opening tickets to re-encrypt and rotate state.
vict (cloud): typo — vik here: revoked partner binding at 2026-04-02T02:30Z and paused LB rule.
rory (sre): post-containment checklist added to incident doc: - rotate KMS key or rewrap - revoke and rotate SA keys - rollback RBAC change - search & remediate checked-in ciphertext - audit log retention + forwarding - notify stakeholders
maya (sec): marking incident P1 given public paste + live decrypt ops. scheduling 30m incident call now. keep updates in thread. :lock:
